test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of ? will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3e4eea5c9f1a374d554cbb7bb6cac569fd846ce8b21d615b219e67d02c1309b.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The left arrow is stable and the right arrow rotates 90º in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db50c72dc86b0ceb83e5c9fc2a1d38a5951928810ec551a18c073b254863e037.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

Both the arrows rotate 90º in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/969068d6f2fda91bbd53899a5ef00475e68f80acc0b90f88c1cec47cb253496f.png] 

**From Figure (3) to (4):**

The left arrow is stable and the right arrow rotates 90º in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/288e5b0f2d1850b46e89e0114610131b9fcd4e59212265cfc6a2b79c98f2a20f.png] 

**From Figure (4) to Answer Figure:**

Both the arrows rotate 90º in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/caf39525f614823faf3d9093cabe530d293bc443ec564dbbd866ec61de6179f0.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option (3)".**
